method: Initial assistant visual inspection of all 653 vocabulary images and 23 portraits, joined to both language packs. Replacements reviewed at 112px/light and 56px/dark; 65 corrected mappings, personalization, café flows, map geometry, media, recording, resume, offline loading and progress preservation verified locally. Historical source findings and rejected masters are preserved.

findings.reason: Moon and stars make this night, while the same lesson teaches good night separately.
findings.brief: Keep the greeting gesture; show orange-pink sunset with the sun partly below the horizon. No moon, stars or sleeping person.
findings.resolution: Reviewed replacement pics/art-v2/semantic-good-evening.webp integrated for the specific affected mappings; unrelated noun uses retained.

findings.reason: Same host, turquoise cup, steam and question mark as some-tea. The drink cannot be identified reliably.
findings.brief: Danutė offers a tall coffee pot toward a small cup of dark coffee; large visible coffee beans. Keep the question cue. No tea tag or lemon.
findings.resolution: Reviewed replacement pics/art-v2/semantic-some-coffee.webp integrated for the specific affected mappings; unrelated noun uses retained.

findings.reason: Indistinguishable from some-coffee at vocabulary-card scale.
findings.brief: Danutė offers a rounded teapot beside a clear cup of pale amber tea, prominent tea tag and lemon. Keep the question cue. No coffee beans.
findings.resolution: Reviewed replacement pics/art-v2/semantic-some-tea.webp integrated for the specific affected mappings; unrelated noun uses retained.

findings.reason: Same turquoise mug and dark liquid as tea; only tea's tiny tag separates the pair. These are also interactive drink targets.
findings.brief: Small espresso cup with very dark coffee, crema and clearly visible coffee beans. Preserve a silhouette unlike the tea glass.
findings.resolution: Reviewed replacement pics/art-v2/semantic-coffee.webp integrated for the specific affected mappings; unrelated noun uses retained.

findings.reason: Tea is shown as a dark drink in the same mug as coffee. The tiny tea tag is insufficient at small sizes.
findings.brief: Clear glass of pale amber tea, large tea tag, lemon slice and small round teapot. Must remain distinguishable from coffee at 56px.
findings.resolution: Reviewed replacement pics/art-v2/semantic-tea.webp integrated for the specific affected mappings; unrelated noun uses retained.

findings.resolution: Reviewed replacement pics/art-v2/semantic-please.webp integrated for the specific affected mappings; unrelated noun uses retained.

findings.reason: A solitary person and question mark communicate a generic question, not asking about someone's wellbeing.
findings.brief: Two people facing each other; caring questioning gesture with a speech bubble containing happy, neutral and sad faces.
findings.resolution: Reviewed replacement pics/art-v2/semantic-how-are-you.webp integrated for the specific affected mappings; unrelated noun uses retained.
Remapped only Quiero dos manzanas to the visually inspected existing art-v2/two-v2 in lang/es.js; the singular noun still uses apple.

findings.brief: Use existing art-v2/two-v2 for this phrase only. Retain apple for the singular noun.

findings.reason: The sentence says there are two chairs; the picture shows one.
findings.brief: New asset with exactly two complete matching chairs. Keep the single-chair noun mapping unchanged.
findings.resolution: Reviewed replacement pics/art-v2/semantic-es-chair-v2.webp integrated for the specific affected mappings; unrelated noun uses retained.

findings.reason: The cat is upright with open eyes; the sentence says it sleeps.

findings.resolution: Reviewed replacement pics/art-v2/semantic-cat-v2.webp integrated for the specific affected mappings; unrelated noun uses retained.

findings.reason: The distant destination is a house, while the sentence identifies a shop.

findings.resolution: Reviewed replacement pics/art-v2/semantic-far.webp integrated for the specific affected mappings; unrelated noun uses retained.

findings.reason: A smiling live fish is shared by Lithuanian fish in the food unit, Spanish el pescado (food) and el pez (animal). It erases the Spanish food/animal distinction.

findings.resolution: Reviewed replacement pics/art-v2/semantic-fish.webp integrated for the specific affected mappings; unrelated noun uses retained.

findings.reason: A casual greeting between two people does not clearly establish a formal or plural greeting. An older person is already present, so the previous note that nothing suggests politeness is too strong.
findings.brief: Respectful nod or offered handshake toward an older stranger and a second adult. Keep distinct from the casual hello wave.
findings.resolution: Reviewed replacement pics/art-v2/semantic-hello-formal.webp integrated for the specific affected mappings; unrelated noun uses retained.

findings.reason: The walking pose already suggests departure, but the front-facing wave is still very similar to hello. The older rejection overstates the lack of departure cues.
findings.brief: Three-quarter rear view moving through an open doorway, looking back and waving, bag over shoulder.
findings.resolution: Reviewed replacement pics/art-v2/semantic-bye.webp integrated for the specific affected mappings; unrelated noun uses retained.

findings.reason: Pulling an existing sleeve is a weak cue for getting dressed rather than stretching or adjusting clothes.
findings.brief: Learner visibly putting on a jacket, with one arm in and one arm entering the other sleeve.
findings.resolution: Reviewed replacement pics/art-v2/semantic-i-get-dressed.webp integrated for the specific affected mappings; unrelated noun uses retained.

findings.resolution: Reviewed replacement pics/art-v2/semantic-shampoo.webp integrated for the specific affected mappings; unrelated noun uses retained.

findings.reason: Cake suggests a birthday but omits the distinguishing month, May.

findings.resolution: Reviewed replacement pics/art-v2/semantic-cake.webp integrated for the specific affected mappings; unrelated noun uses retained.

findings.reason: Books are shown, but there is no clear new-versus-old cue.

findings.resolution: Reviewed replacement pics/art-v2/semantic-books.webp integrated for the specific affected mappings; unrelated noun uses retained.

findings.reason: The US flag matches the default literal text. index.html excludes country sentences from ART_AS aliasing; a changed country normally loses this illustration rather than retaining the wrong US flag. The earlier rejection's always-shows-US claim is inaccurate.
findings.brief: A generic learner-to-globe/map-pin scene can cover personalized origin, but it must be connected to the country-personalization path explicitly, not just overwrite this file.
findings.resolution: Personalized origin sentences now resolve to a neutral learner/globe/pin diagram in both languages. Browser checks passed with Canada and Japan; the literal US mapping remains valid for the unpersonalized source phrase.

findings.reason: Name changes depend on language-specific personalization and alias handling. A static inventory cannot certify every personalized variant keeps its picture.
findings.brief: Validate both languages with changed names and learner genders. Neutral blank name badge is suitable; avoid printing Tomas in artwork.
findings.resolution: Neutral name-badge diagram mapped to the introduction phrases and retained through the actual personalization path. Browser checks passed with Ava in both languages.

findings.reason: The teacher is correctly shown teaching; personalized gender or job changes require their own runtime check. Do not treat a male teacher as the universal picture for all jobs.
findings.brief: Retain this for the male teacher. Verify female and other-job variants resolve to the matching existing profession picture or remain text-only.
findings.resolution: Female teacher and Lithuanian female student forms use existing matching artwork. Changed job sentences without an exact suitable illustration stay text-only instead of inheriting the student or male-teacher picture. Browser checks cover female teachers in both languages and actual Lithuanian teacher/engineer job substitutions.

interactive.finding: The writing adventure reuses the weak coffee/tea pair; reading/listening practice has text-only drink choices.
interactive.action: Replace the drink pair first. Add both neutral drink thumbnails to choices equally, without marking which one is correct. Keep target-language text and accessible button names.
interactive.resolution: Distinct reviewed espresso and tea-glass images are connected to the words and both drink choices in the reading/listening practice and writing adventure. Both choices receive equal thumbnails and retain accessible text names. Both-language real reading/listening checks passed.

interactive.finding: The same host portrait appears at every stage. Before choosing a drink, Your table already shows coffee because the empty choice falls through to coffee. Object buttons are appended only during drink choice, so later bill/payment states have no corresponding object.
interactive.action: Show an empty table before selection, the selected drink after ordering, an empty cup after finishing, then a bill and payment terminal at the relevant stage. Existing menu and portrait are reusable; do not show an order as already delivered before the learner orders.
interactive.resolution: Empty table before ordering, selected drink as a choice rather than a delivered order, empty coffee cup or tea glass after finishing, then isolated bill and terminal at the payment stage. Resume, independent/assisted completion, 320px layout and offline image reload passed without changing course state.

interactive.finding: The cv1 story describes a crowded café and one free seat. Current conversation renderer shows portraits and dialogue; no seat/counter hotspot implementation or asset reference was found. Both requested images are absent.
interactive.action: Keep free-seat and cafe-counter as planned scene assets. Connect them only when the interactive scene is implemented. The free seat belongs beside Rūta, who has coffee; the waiter in cv1 is Darius, so do not automatically use Danutė as the host in this scene.
interactive.resolution: Reviewed empty-seat and crowded-counter assets are connected to an optional Look around the café panel in the actual cv1 conversation. Each button gives scene feedback; no dialogue or saved conversation IDs changed. The empty-seat image contains no substitute character. Actual replay and button checks passed.

interactive.finding: Directions use a labelled 3×3 grid: library west, shop east, park north, learner facing north.
interactive.action: Retain this exact geometry. Existing library/shop/park icons can supplement labels; use a code-rendered north arrow and paths so left/right cannot be reversed by generated artwork. Never add a second map that conflicts with the accessible description.
interactive.resolution: Existing park, library and shop illustrations supplement the labelled map in all three runners. North/left/right geometry is preserved in code. Actual mobile directions practice verified all three image positions and no overflow.

interactive.finding: Prices, times, family, rooms and shopping sources are mostly rendered as text panels rather than illustrated documents/scenes.
interactive.action: Use code-rendered exact price tags, calendars and clock faces; use matched family diagrams and room layouts where they are the source of information. Put decorative illustrations outside the answer-bearing reading/listening area so an image does not disclose an answer being tested from text or audio.
interactive.resolution: Neutral topic illustrations appear on the practice briefings for home, family, shopping, prices, schedules and messages. Exact source text and amounts remain app-rendered, and task answer panels receive no answer-revealing decoration. The directions map is the illustrated source where geography is the task.

new_interactive_asset_briefs.brief: One visibly empty wooden café chair pulled out from a small round table; a coffee cup at the neighbouring occupied place, suitable for Rūta's cv1 scene. Transparent background; complete silhouette; no text.
Café counter with till, pastries and a queue of three people seen from behind; unmistakably busy. Transparent background; broad shapes readable at mobile size; no text.
Small café table with an empty place setting and no drink, food or bill; neutral pre-choice state. Transparent background.
The selected café drink's cup after use: visibly empty, on its saucer, without steam. Use separate coffee/tea variants if their vessel silhouettes differ.
Standalone café bill on a small tray. Blank broad receipt lines; exact totals supplied by the app if needed. No person already paying.
Standalone card terminal with an obvious contactless symbol and separate bank card. Neutral waiting state, no success tick before the learner asks to pay.
